fields.label: Cloudflare API Token
fields.description: Token with Zone.DNS Edit and Zone.Zone Read permissions for your Cloudflare account.

fields.label: Default Zone ID
fields.description: Cloudflare zone ID used for relative hostnames and auto-provisioned records.

fields.label: Base Domain
fields.description: Default zone apex (e.g. example.com). Bare subdomains entered by users are appended to this domain.

fields.label: Auto-provision on install
fields.description: Automatically create A and SRV records when a server finishes installing.

fields.label: Default TTL
fields.description: Default DNS TTL for new records (1 = automatic for Cloudflare).

fields.label: SRV Profiles
fields.description: Profile definitions for game/service SRV records. Use preset IDs (minecraft-java, factorio, etc.) or custom service/proto objects.

fields.label: Enabled SRV Profiles
fields.description: SRV service profiles enabled for this server. Sync SRV records after changing this list.
